title.zh: X Adds US 'Trade' Button to Cashtags With Coinbase, Kraken and Gemini
title.en: X Adds US 'Trade' Button to Cashtags With Coinbase, Kraken and Gemini

current_state.zh: X has launched a US 'Trade' button on cashtags that routes users to partner brokerages Coinbase, Kraken, and Gemini to complete crypto transactions directly.
